metadata.title: Topological mapping class groups of non-simply connected 4-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We construct topological isotopy invariants of homeomorphisms of non-simply connected 4-manifolds using the topological Dax invariant of disks and the Freedman-Quinn invariant of spheres. Our invariants are effective for various non-smoothable 4-manifolds without assuming that the fundamental groups are good. They detect infinite-rank free abelian direct factors of the pseudoisotopy-trivial and homotopy-trivial mapping class groups, and give lower bounds on the Prüfer rank of the Torelli groups modulo homotopy-trivial mapping classes, including examples of infinite Prüfer rank. Our method is also useful for smooth 4-manifolds. We construct stably smoothable homeomorphisms of the Enriques surface and many Dolgachev surfaces that act trivially on homology but are not homotopic to the identity.

analysis.progressType: 四维同胚的同位不变量
analysis.workSummary: 用盘的拓扑 Dax 不变量与球的 Freedman–Quinn 不变量构造非单连通四流形同胚的同位不变量，检测无限秩映射类群因子及 Torelli 群的秩下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 适用于多种不可光滑化例子而不需基本群为 good，并构造同调平凡但非同伦平凡的稳定可光滑化同胚。
analysis.limitations: 同位、伪同位、同伦与同调平凡四个层次必须区分，不可互换。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
